newsitem.title: UK: Libya warns European states over reaction force.
newsitem.headline: Libya warns European states over reaction force.

text.p: Libya has warned Italy, France, Spain and Portugal that it will retaliate against their new rapid reaction force by helping the IRA in Britain and similar groups in other European countries, Libyan television reported.

Libya viewed the force as a declaration of war, had consulted its Maghreb Union neighbours and Egypt, and had fully mobilised its armed forces, Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi said in remarks carried by the television, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation late on Monday.
"They are waging war. This is considered a declaration of war by Europe...," said Gaddafi.

"I have informed the leaders of the Arab states, whom I contacted yesterday, that we have declared full mobilisation and we will be heading for the shores of the Mediterranean and will have our fingers on the trigger, because that (European) force has been formed and its objective has been defined. The only thing left was an order to attack our independent states and enter into our homes."

On Saturday, France, Italy, Spain and Portugal constituted a joint rapid reaction force for future use on humanitarian and peacekeeping missions in conflicts like the one now devastating eastern Zaire.
Known as Eurofor, it would be able to call on up to 10,000 troops depending on the scale of any crisis it was asked to tackle once fully operational.
Italian Defence Minister Beniamino Andreatta said the force would "give our countries an instrument capable of strengthening a common security policy".
Officials said the role of Eurofor was to conduct humanitarian and peacekeeping and peace enforcement missions and it would be made available to the 10-nation Western European Union.
The force could also be put at the disposal of NATO and the United Nations.
"This is a new adventure, a new international terrorism and we utterly reject it," said Gaddafi.
"European regimes are themselves shaky. They do not have security and their affairs are unstable.

"Britain suffers from civil war with bombs and guns in the middle of London between the Irish Republican Army (IRA) and the British. This means we will need a force to intervene in Britain and a force to intervene in the Balkans and a force to intervene in the European states.
"Indeed, if they do not reconsider their position, we announce here openly that if they were seeking war we will declare it."
